request.style: English, female solo voice, warm and reverent, acoustic guitar, piano, cello, soft percussion, hopeful mood, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Out of Babylon we came
To Jerusalem and Judah
Walking back to our own town
Each man to his own place

[Verse]
Under Zerubbabel's lead
With Jeshua and Nehemiah
We climbed up from the exile
Restoring what was lost

[Chorus]
The sons of Hasupha
Temple servants faithful
Serving at the house
Keeping the sacred trust

[Verse]
Alongside Ziha and Tabbaoth
In the list of the returned
We settled near the temple
To carry out our part

[Chorus]
The sons of Hasupha
Temple servants faithful
Serving at the house
Keeping the sacred trust

[Bridge]
Lived on Ophel high
Serving God's holy place
Duties assigned to us
In this restored time

[Outro]
The sons of Hasupha
Faithful to the end
